newsitem.title: USA: Delta board declined to renew Allen - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Delta board declined to renew Allen - WSJ.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc's board of directors had declined to renew former Chairman Ronald Allen's contract, partly out of concern that his cost cuts were eating into employee morale and customer service, the Wall Street Journal said.

In Friday's electronic edition, the Journal said that even though the cuts initiated under Allen helped pull the nation's third-largest carrier out of a financial tailspin, company directors were not necessarily pleased with his management style.
One unidentified source said company directors began weighing "an accumulation of abrasions over time" that had undermined confidence in Allen's leadership.
Earlier this month, the company announced that Allen had decided to retire when his contract expires on July 31.
Allen declined to comment to the Journal about his departure. "I just cannot comment beyond the four corners of the press release" announcing his retirement, Allen said in a handwritten note.
